messages:
olivia_h: Heads-upUX Research Engineer candidate Anya S. scheduled for hybrid loop Tue Apr 7. In-person 11:00:00 PT, remote panel 15:30:00 PT. Need ops: room, badge, loaner, lunch, parking stipend, accessibility.
ben_k: Confirm candidate timezone? calendar shows PT.
olivia_h: Yes PT (San Diego).
priya: I can handle badge + vouchers. Diet?
olivia_h: Pescatarian, gluten-free.
peopleops_bot: Checklist created: room booking, badge pickup, loaner device, parking code, lunch voucher, stipend form.
ben_k: Request Conf C 10:45:15 for buffer. Conf C has A/V and wheelchair access.
sam_p: I'll make a Zoom fallback and private panel channel.
ellie_ops: Day-of ops contact: +1-415-555-0123. I'll staff Reception.
mike_r: Expense code for local parking reimbursement?
priya: Use OPS-INT-TRAVEL. Cap $60 with receipt.
olivia_h: Parking lot B, kiosk code 47-11. Badge pickup at Reception, bring ID.
candidate_portal: Candidate packet sent. Please ask Anya to upload ID and signed NDA here: https://portal.redwood.example/upload (deadline 48h before loop).
ben_k: Loaner laptop: need dev VM, Chrome + Zoom, local admin for tests. Any M1/M2 machines?
priya: 13" M2 loaner available. IT will pre-stage account and Wi-Fi.
sam_p: Zoom link created: https://zoom.redwood.example/j/987654321 passcode: loop2026. Channel #interview-anya created.
peopleops_bot: Calendar invite sent (ID: 1932200017-UX-ANYA) with 24h and 30m reminders.
ben_k: Need quiet pairing room with HDMI 14:00:00.
priya: Reserving Conf B for pairing.
mike_r: Travel stipend approved $150 pre-arrival. Who coordinates payout?
priya: I'll handle payout. DM me details; we use Venmo/ACH.
olivia_h: Accessibility: requested extra lighting and noise-cancelling headphones for task.
peopleops_bot: Accommodation logged. Headphones at front desk; portable lamp available.
sam_p: Reminder: recordings off, panelists mute when not speaking.
olivia_h: We'll keep 10-min buffers between interviews.
priya: Lunch vouchers will be digital codes sent to recruiter by EOD.
ben_k: Onsite access: add candidate to 'guest' group with limited apps. IT confirm?
priya: IT confirmed guest account on loaner.
mike_r: Background check timeline question from candidate: we do checks post-offer. Communicated that.
olivia_h: Candidate prefers video-only intro with hiring manager (no handshake). Front desk to be informed.
ellie_ops: NotedReception instructed.
peopleops_bot: Arrival instructions reminder scheduled 24h before.
olivia_h: Anything else?
ben_k: Post on-call number in #interview-anya for day-of issues.
sam_p: Done: posted day-of ops contact +1-415-555-0123 (Ellie).
priya: Sending parking voucher/promo codes and stipend confirmation once details received.
mike_r: Recruiter to confirm ETA tomorrow. Thanks team.
olivia_h: Thanks all :raised_hands:
